mapper.select: select t1.hot_table_id as hotTableId, t1.source_table_name as sourceTableName, t1.hot_table_name as hotTableName, t1.hot_db_engine as hotDbEngine, t1.hot_data_init_days as hotDataInitDays, t1.data_min_date as dataMinDate, t1.data_max_date as dataMaxDate, t1.data_finish_time as dataFinishTime, t1.etl_script_id as etlScriptId, t1.etl_script_name as etlScriptName, t1.etl_job_name as etlJobName, t1.is_active as isActive, t1.created_by as createdBy, date_format(t1.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, t1.updated_by as updatedBy, date_format(t1.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedTime from ssm_hot_table_info t1 where 1=1 and t1.is_active = 1 and EXISTS ( select 1 from ssm_hot_table_source t2 where t2.source_table_name = t1.source_table_name and t2.is_active = 1 ) order by createdTime

select t1.hot_table_id as hotTableId, t1.source_table_name as sourceTableName, t1.hot_table_name as hotTableName, t1.hot_db_engine as hotDbEngine, t1.hot_data_init_days as hotDataInitDays, t1.data_min_date as dataMinDate, t1.data_max_date as dataMaxDate, t1.data_finish_time as dataFinishTime, t1.etl_script_id as etlScriptId, t1.etl_script_name as etlScriptName, t1.etl_job_name as etlJobName, t1.is_active as isActive, t1.created_by as createdBy, date_format(t1.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdTime, t1.updated_by as updatedBy, date_format(t1.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedTime from ssm_hot_table_info t1 where 1=1 and t1.is_active = 1 and t1.source_table_name = #{sourceTableName}
